rule: RULE-BASED. Landmarks measured on this body's own bones (soft-tissue points: the proxy in their definition, flagged proxy); IZ level = pct along the line from its first landmark; band = the muscle's section by the plane perpendicular to the line at that level (point lines: the nearest inside point); FAILED when the plane / point misses the muscle by more than 5 mm.

subscap_line_upper.label: Midpoint spine medial end - acromion tip

posterior_axillary_fold.label: Posterior axillary fold
posterior_axillary_fold.proxy_rule: Skin fold over the lower border of latissimus dorsi / teres major at the axilla. Not a bony point: on a body without a usable skin surface, take the most lateral-inferior point of the teres major + latissimus dorsi pair at the level of the scapula inferior angle, and say so on the badge.

popliteal_fold.label: Popliteal fold
popliteal_fold.proxy_rule: Skin crease behind the knee. Not a bony point: proxy = posterior point of the femoral_intercondylar_mid level (the knee joint line level), badged as a proxy.

submalleolar_point.label: Submalleolar point
submalleolar_point.proxy_rule: Named by the guide for EHL but not defined there. Proxy = lateral_malleolus_tip, badged as undefined in the source.
